# i-have-adhd synchronization

This fork-owned control plane synchronizes
`ayghri/i-have-adhd/skills/i-have-adhd/` into
`skills/productivity/i-have-adhd/`.

The upstream root `LICENSE` is installed beside the skill. The adapter sets
explicit-only invocation in `SKILL.md` and skips non-Antigravity metadata under
`agents/`. Every update is proposed through a pull request and requires human
review.

`upstream-lock.json` records the exact source commit and upstream inventory.
